Sometime after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] owned a heavily-modified [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] [[Star Courier/Legends|Star Courier]]&mdash;also known as a '''Sith Infiltrator''', similar to the [[Scimitar/Legends|one]] he gave his apprentice [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] some fifteen years earlier. He stored the ship in [[the Crypt]], his secret personal hangar on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After being infected by the necrotic virus [[Aorth-6]], Palpatine was temporarily taken to the Crypt and secured aboard the ship to recover. The infiltrator was equipped with a [[Stasis chamber/Legends|stasis chamber]] and a [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]], both of which were used to prolong the Emperor's life. However, [[Trachta]] was later forced to destroy the latter after [[Gentis]] sent in a signal that reprogrammed all droids to target [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] loyal to Palpatine. The Sith Infiltrator was later used to transport Palpatine to [[the Prism]].
